comment: An agent-written settings screen with form controls: a centered card, a two-column grid of rows (label and control), a text input focused (author outline with offset), a select, a range with accent-color, checkboxes in inline-flex labels, and buttons. Text-heavy (boxes are the oracle): the glyph rasterization differs from Chromium's (FreeType hinting, synthetic bold outline vs bitmap dilation); the page without its text is gated at the strict metric (noText).
